## Goal
`src/freemyid/engine/htmlsel.py` is exercised only through the exposure scan and the depth tests (`tests/test_qa_v03_review.py:160-195`). Its documented grammar (7-10) and refusal rules (188-226) have no direct table test.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. Each supported form (htmlsel.py:7-9: `tag`, `*`, `.class`, `#id`, `[attr]`, `[attr=value]` quoted and unquoted, compounds like `a.view[href]`, descendant, child, comma lists) selects exactly the expected nodes from a small fixture page written inside the test.
2. Unsupported forms (`a + b`, `a ~ b`, `:hover`, `::before`, `[href^=x]`, `[href*=x]`, `a >`, `> a`, `a,,b`, empty, a very long selector) raise `UnsupportedSelector` (191, 206, 211, 217, 223) and never return a guess.
3. Text inside `script`, `style`, `noscript`, `template`, `head` and `title` (`_SKIP_TEXT` 25) never appears in `Node.text()`; void elements (24) don't swallow their siblings.
4. A page with more than `MAX_NODES` (18) tags parses without error and the tree holds at most `MAX_NODES` element nodes (103, 121, 144).
5. A comma list returns each node once, in document order (`select` 82-86).
6. Any case above that fails today is fixed in `htmlsel.py` (Codex code lane) without widening the grammar; the exposure tests still pass.

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing; re-check them.
